description: The partial inverse to doubling has output \(y\) at input \(x\) exactly when \(x=2y\). Its domain is therefore precisely the even natural numbers.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PartialRecursiveFunctions.inverseDouble_spec (x y : ℕ) :
  y ∈ Lemmatheca.Entry.PartialRecursiveFunctions.inverseDouble (List.Vector.ofFn fun x_1 => x) ↔ x = 2 * y
